claims.paper_rule: RL MM Agent: decision and action networks trained by PPO
claims.runtime_rule: Two categorical policies, explicit joint behavior log-probability binding, clipped objective and value regression

claims.paper_rule: RL MM Agent: imitate previous trajectories with return above current value estimate
claims.runtime_rule: Positive-advantage actor and value losses; no imitation from nonpositive-return advantage

claims.paper_rule: Training RL Agent, Table4: rho=0,+1,-1 denotes absent,buy,sell metaorder
claims.runtime_rule: Price/inventory/Hawkes-intensity/rho observations; post or cancel top-of-book quotes through contract1.1

differences: Five observations and width8 networks replace the full source high-dimensional LOB networks.
Training uses a late-start rPOV2-style prefix instead of the source rPOV1 training metaorder; evaluation observes eight unit children.
Three initial on-policy rollouts and four rounds sampling 32 transitions each, with one SGD update per transition (128 steps), replace 140+ training episodes.

Interval probability fill approximation may fill an off-touch resting quote; it does not enforce exchange price priority. Quote stream uses bounded exponential Hawkes excitation with metaorder flow; not the original compound full LOB.
Queue, deep-book, partial fills, endogenous market-maker impact and original urgency-based TWAP agent are excluded.
100-second warmup, .213-second action step and 40-second metaorder interval are retained in the bounded setup.
One-basis-point per-fill fee differs from the source liquidation fee; the exact configured ledger is reported.
No original Sharpe, slippage, square-root impact or full-system pressure-test reproduction claim.
reproduction_scope: bounded local method adaptation; not full paper experiment

source.title: When AI Trading Agents Compete: Adverse Selection of Meta-Orders by Reinforcement Learning-Based Market Making
